answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. The sparrow decay curve is applied at each close, dawn records the drop, and lagoon recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 2 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A 456 account operation therefore ties up 37 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
